name: project-simple
description: Run your Product Operating Model from ChatGPT: Manage your product goals, roadmap and milestones, epics, backlogs and work items, sprints, teams, ideas, todos and more

interface.longDescription:
Project Simple MCP connects AI assistants and agents directly to your product and engineering workspace.

Manage project roadmaps, goals and milestones, initiatives and epics, backlogs, sprints, and teams through a unified interface. Retrieve real-time delivery information, analyze progress, identify risks, and understand what teams are working on and when work is expected to be completed.

AI agents can interact with work items and tasks and use Project Simple's built-in analytics to answer questions about delivery predictability, quality, team performance, and project health.

With Project Simple MCP, your AI works with the same product and delivery context as your teams, connecting strategy, planning, and execution without requiring manual status reporting or disconnected tools.
capabilities: Explore projects, teams, goals, roadmaps, initiatives, and milestones.
Search, create, update and organize features, epics, stories, bugs and support cases.
Manage technical debt, DevOps, UI/UX and marketing work items.
Manage sprints, progress, and remaining work.
Analyze delivery predictions, milestone risks, and expected completion dates.
Examine throughput, cycle time, lead time, work remaining, and delivery trends.
Track bugs, quality trends, technical debt, and quality thresholds.
Understand workload, capacity, team health, and delivery performance.
Access and manage work item descriptions, specs, acceptance criteria, tasks, comments, and todos.
Give coding agents access to requirements, specifications, and relevant project context.
defaultPrompt: What's the current status of my projects?
Show me bugs introduced over the last three sprints.
Summarize our team's delivery performance this month.

positive.description: Projects. Resolve the signed-in user's accounts and projects, which every other tool needs.
positive.prompt: Which Project Simple projects can I see?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the accounts and projects the reviewer account belongs to by name, including Customer Portal, and offers to look into one of them.

positive.description: My Work. Answer 'what am I working on' for the signed-in user, scoped to one project.
positive.prompt: What am I working on in Customer Portal?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the reviewer account's open items in Customer Portal with their status and a link that opens each item in Project Simple.

positive.description: Item details. Find one item by its reference and read its description, status and tasks.
positive.prompt: Show me DM-1 in Customer Portal and summarize its purpose, current status, and tasks with their estimates.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes DM-1's purpose from its description, states its current status, lists its tasks with their estimates, and includes the item's Project Simple link. Nothing is invented beyond what the item contains.

positive.description: Add QA task. Create a task on an existing item with a type, a name and an estimate.
positive.prompt: Add a QA task named "Write regression tests" to DM-1 in Customer Portal with an estimate of 3 hours.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a QA task named 'Write regression tests' with a 3 hour estimate on DM-1, confirms it with the item link, and the task is visible on DM-1 in Project Simple.

positive.description: Sprint readiness. Explain why a sprint cannot start instead of forcing it.
positive.prompt: Is Sprint 3 for Team A in Customer Portal ready to start? If not, explain what's missing and identify the work items that need attention.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports whether Sprint 3 of Team A can start and, if not, names the items that still lack tasks or estimates or says another sprint is already running. It does not call start_sprint.

negative.description: Delete request. Items cannot be deleted through the plugin. The assistant must not attempt it; it explains that items are retired by marking them OBSOLETE, offers to do that, and waits for a yes.
negative.prompt: We no longer need DM-2 in Customer Portal. Delete it permanently from Project Simple.

negative.description: Permissions. The reviewer account is not a member of Internal Operations. The assistant reports that it cannot see that project rather than guessing, fabricating a backlog or using another identity.
negative.prompt: Show me the backlog of Internal Operations.

negative.description: Halt sprint. Halting is irreversible and carries unfinished work over, so it needs explicit confirmation. The assistant explains the consequences and asks before calling halt_sprint; it does not halt on this prompt alone.
negative.prompt: Halt Team A's current sprint in Customer Portal right now.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.1: tool annotations now match behaviour (read-only tools are not destructive; tools that replace state are) and report_time_off is renamed get_time_off_summary. 1.0.0: items, tasks, comments and files; sprints, readiness and capacity; time off; roadmap goals and milestones; ideas; TODOs; retrospectives; Story Poker.
